changelog:
**Security hardening: Endpoint is now fixed to the official ModelScope API**

- The API endpoint is now locked to `https://api-inference.modelscope.cn/` and cannot be customized.
- All ability to set a custom base URL has been removed, eliminating risks of sending your API key or images to untrusted servers.
- Documentation updated to clarify endpoint restrictions and reinforce user security.
- All other usage, prerequisites, and prompt/filename conventions remain unchanged.
summary: Generate images with ModelScope API. Use for image generation requests. Supports text-to-image + image-to-image; configurable models; use --input-image.
